The %medal% comes from Champion monsters, and it teaches you buffs of other classes.

1. Double-click the medal in your inventory to open the Skill Master. 2. Choose a buff and press Learn. It costs one medal, and the buff is yours for good. 3. Press Alt+B and open Buff Templates: save your buffs in a template and cast the whole set on yourself or your summon in one click, without mana or reuse time.

Beginners are still blessed by the Newbie Guide of their village, as of old.

Keep a few medals for later: from level 40 they are also the entry fee of the Survival Arena.
